component.name: GlassLight
component.summary: Create generative art from refracted light

description.p: GlassLight traces light through seeded, procedural glass forms and renders only the resulting colored caustics on a textured wall.
Explore Pebble, Lens, Ribbon, Faceted Vessel, Cut Crystal, and Fracture forms through a responsive GPU preview, refine still images, and export seamless video loops.
Adds Faceted Vessel, Cut Crystal, and Fracture families, with GPU-rendered preview validation and expanded deterministic export checks.
